# skycloak_cluster_extension (Resource)

Installs a marketplace extension on a cluster. Installation is asynchronous; the `status` reflects provisioning progress. Changing `extension_id` or `parameters` reinstalls the extension.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a marketplace extension by name.
data "skycloak_extensions" "all" {}

locals {
  magic_link_id = one([for e in data.skycloak_extensions.all.extensions : e.id if e.name == "Magic Link"])
}

resource "skycloak_cluster_extension" "magic_link" {
  cluster_id   = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  extension_id = local.magic_link_id

  parameters = {
    sender_email = "no-reply@example.com"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `extension_id` (String) Catalog extension ID (see the `skycloak_extensions` data source). Immutable.

### Optional

- `parameters` (Map of String, Sensitive) Parameter values keyed by parameter `key`. Write-only (sensitive values are never read back). Changing this reinstalls the extension.

### Read-Only

- `available_version` (String) Latest available version.
- `extension_name` (String) Extension display name.
- `id` (String) Composite ID `cluster_id/extension_id`.
- `installed_at` (String) Install timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `installed_version` (String) Version currently running on the cluster.
- `source` (String) Extension source (`marketplace`, `custom`).
- `status` (String) Installation status.
- `upgrade_available` (Boolean) Whether a newer version is available.
